variants.name: Viper Poison Cloud
variants.label: Viper's poison cloud ability surrounds the avatar. Hope you brought a mask.

variants.name: Reyna's Leer
variants.label: Reyna's Leer ability surrounds the avatar, nearsighting all those who dare to stare into its gaze.

variants.name: A Hint of Clove
variants.label: Clove's special smoke ability wraps around the avatar, with several fluttering, glowing butterflies.

variants.name: Omen's Cowl
variants.label: The avatar wears Omen's signature hood.

variants.name: Cypher Neural Theft

variants.name: FRAG OUT

variants.name: Blade Storm
variants.label: The avatar equips throwing knives from Jett's signature Blade Storm ability.

variants.label: A midnight-blue diadem adorned with a glowing enchanted gem in the center. As the gem glows, it emits a magical shimmer throughout the diadem.

variants.name: Malefic Crown
variants.label: A sinister crown with sharp ornamental spikes and a glowing jewel engraved in its center. The jewel emits a dark energy across the crown that grants the wearer incredible power and style points.

variants.name: Death's Edge
variants.label: A fearsome razor-edged sword with mysterious symbols engraved across its blade radiates with a dark and electrical power from tip to hilt.

variants.name: Spirit Embers
variants.label: Wisps of luminous, ethereal embers swirl around the avatar. They make for a helpful lightsource for dark areas yet to be explored.

variants.name: Eldritch Ring
variants.label: A cursed ring covered with shadowy roots and enveloped in flickering cursed flames. It may grant its wearer new powers, but at what cost?

variants.name: Arcane Sigil
variants.label: A circular sigil inscribed with mysterious symbols enframed around the avatar glows with a magical energy.

variants.name: Black Hole
variants.label: A mesmerizing dark hole swirls around the avatar, drawing everyone into its mysterious depths.

variants.name: Constellations
variants.label: Star constellations decorate the avatar, inviting profile admirers for a fun session of stargazing.

variants.name: Stardust

variants.name: Solar Orbit
variants.label: Three planets orbit around an avatar engulfed by solar flames.

variants.name: Astronaut Helmet
variants.label: The avatar wears an astronaut helmet. Protecting your head is always a good look.

variants.name: UFO
variants.label: A UFO appears and emits an abduction beam before flying away... talk about a grab-and-go.

variants.name: Cozy Cat

variants.name: Oasis
variants.label: Stringlights and a lovely houseplant adorn the frame of the avatar for the ultimate cozy mood.

variants.name: Cybernetic

variants.label: After booting up, a wave of neon colors transforms into a sunset that embraces this avatar. Why do I suddenly feel calmer?

variants.label: A surge of energy pulses through wires perched on top of this avatar. Electricity dangerously crackles over the image. Be careful with this one!

variants.name: Fire

variants.name: Water

variants.name: Balance
variants.label: Fire, rock, water, and electricity revolve around the avatar's frame.

variants.name: Crossbones
